## Project context

This section belongs to the project and may be edited by its maintainers. On the first session, derive the project purpose, stack, package manager, and available dev/test/build commands from repository files and existing documentation. Record useful findings here with their source. Keep absent or ambiguous facts **unknown**; do not invent commands or install tools to fill gaps.

Read existing project instructions and constraints before implementation. Ask only about consequential missing requirements that block the requested work. Routine discovered context needs no approval.

## Context sources

- `.claude/STATE.md`: agreed scope, dependency order, gate evidence, blockers, exact next action.
- `tasks/todo.md`: checkable plan, Finished, Still not done, and review results.
- `tasks/lessons.md`: preventive rules from prior corrections and confirmed causes.
- Existing manifests, scripts, and architecture documentation: actual stack, commands, and boundaries.

Create or update documentation only when needed for the task. Preserve project-owned instructions outside the managed imports when syncing moskills.
